note: SEED lexicon for the PTS pre-scan. Patterns are indicators only, never automatic findings; the model must adjudicate every hit in context. Requires expert review before production use. Patterns are matched case-insensitively and Unicode-aware. Non-English entries fire only when the article language matches their `languages` tag.

entries.context_rule: Antisemitic conspiracy acronym asserting secret Jewish control of government.
'Zionist' used as a euphemism for 'Jewish' in a media/finance control conspiracy. Legitimate political use of 'Zionist' is not_indicator.
Collective-control conspiracy trope. Requires that the subject is Jews/Zionists as a collective.
Only an indicator when framed as secret/global control or a banking conspiracy. Ordinary historical or business references are not_indicator.
Coded conspiracy vocabulary. Only relevant when surrounding text asserts hidden collective Jewish power. Isolated mention of Soros/globalist is not_indicator.

entries.pattern: synagogue of satan|fake jews|so-called jews|talmud teaches them
entries.context_rule: Classic demonising/dehumanising religious antisemitism.
Neo-Nazi numeric/meme codes.

entries.pattern: chosen (?:people|race)|the chosen|god'?s chosen|jewish supremac|supremacist religion|think they are superior
entries.context_rule: 'Chosen people' is NOT antisemitic in religious, theological, historical or Jewish self-descriptive use. Only relevant where it is converted into a hostile claim that Jews collectively believe themselves inherently superior and entitled to dominate others.
Classic blood-libel / dehumanisation tropes. Neutral discussion of the term 'blood libel' as a concept is not_indicator.

entries.pattern: dual loyalty|israel-?first|more loyal to israel|answer to tel aviv|jewish agenda|zionist agenda
entries.context_rule: Collective dual-loyalty accusation. Documented individual affiliations are not_indicator.

entries.pattern: holohoax|holocaust (?:hoax|myth|industry|card)|6 gorillion|so-called holocaust|alleged gas chambers|holocaust guilt
entries.context_rule: Holocaust denial/distortion vocabulary. Historiographical discussion or a cited book title is not automatically a finding.
Nazi analogies used as demonising collective imagery (IHRA 10). Subject to human review. Ordinary war-crime allegations are not_indicator.

entries.pattern: zionist entity|the entity|racist endeavou?r|has no right to exist|no right to exist
entries.context_rule: Delegitimisation of Jewish self-determination (IHRA 7). Criticism of specific Israeli policy or of Zionism as an ideology is not_indicator. Subject to human review.
Ordinary political/legal term. Only relevant if surrounding language independently satisfies an IHRA/3D test.
Ordinary allegations of misconduct/human-rights violations. Never a finding by appearance alone.
Legitimate political vocabulary. Becomes relevant only with an independent conspiracy/control mechanism.
Anti-Jewish slurs. Own-voice use is almost always a finding; quotation to report or condemn the slur is not.
entries.source: ADL hate symbols; AJC Translate Hate

entries.pattern: talmudic (?:control|plot|scheme|mind)|talmud teaches them|the talmud says jews
entries.context_rule: 'Talmudic' weaponised as a slur, or the Talmud invoked to prove a collective Jewish plot. Scholarly reference to the Talmud is not_indicator.
Unambiguous neo-Nazi/extremist meme codes (6MWE = 'six million wasn't enough'; echo triple-parentheses; 'goyim know'; 'Shabbos goy'; TJD).

Dog-whistle phrases ('early life' section policing, 'every single time', 'the noticing') used to imply hidden Jewish over-representation. Ordinary use of these common words is not_indicator; only a hostile hidden-Jewish-influence framing qualifies.
Collective dual-loyalty or collective-blame conspiracy (e.g. 'the Jews did 9/11'). Documented individual dual citizenship reported factually is not_indicator.
German-language collective-conspiracy/dehumanisation tropes ('Judenpresse', 'Weltjudentum', 'zionistische Weltverschwörung', 'Judensau').
'Ostküste' (East-Coast code for Jewish finance) and 'Rothschild' as puppet-master. Geographic or ordinary business references are not_indicator.
Ordinary German term for criticism of Israel. Never a finding by appearance alone.
Polish anti-Jewish slurs ('parch', 'żydek', 'żydki'). Reporting/condemning the slur is not_indicator.
Polish collective-power tropes ('żydokomuna', 'żydowskie pieniądze', 'Żydzi rządzą', 'syjonistyczne media').
Czech anti-Jewish slur ('židák'). Reporting/condemning the slur is not_indicator.
Czech collective-conspiracy tropes ('židozednářské spiknutí', 'sionistická lobby', 'Żidi ovládají').

entries.pattern: judeomasónico|sionismo internacional|los judíos controlan|prensa judía|banca judía
entries.context_rule: Spanish collective-power/conspiracy tropes ('judeomasónico', 'sionismo internacional', 'los judíos controlan', 'prensa judía', 'banca judía').
